([[Duck Hunt Event|Duck Hunt]]) |base_hp = [[File:HealthIcon.png|20px|Health]]20Beyond wave 20, '''Eggroll''' scaled its health with time. |defense = {{Defense}}80% |speed = [[File:SpeedIcon.png|20px|Speed]]Average (3) |spawned_by = [[Cart]] |hidden = No |fly = No |ghost = No |lead = No |immunity = None |ability1 = '''{{WikiAb|Hatch}}''' - Upon death, '''Eggroll''' spawns a random enemy. }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Eggroll''' was an enemy that appeared exclusively in [[D00M's Revenge]] as part of the [[Duck Hunt Event]]. Currently, it can be spawned again in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, though not through [[Logbooks]] as '''Eggroll''' does not appear in [[Ducky Revenge Event]]. Instead, [[Mother Ducky (Ducky Revenge)|Mother Ducky]] has to be summoned to spawn the [[Cart]] into the match which then assuming it does not break spawns in '''Eggrolls'''. It had lower health than the [[Mother Ducky (D00M's Revenge)|Mother Ducky]] and [[Cart]], but it was faster and had an extremely high defense. Beyond wave 20, its health would increase over time. Upon death, the '''Eggroll''' can spawn the [[Ducky (D00M's Revenge)|Ducky]], [[Cool Ducky (D00M's Revenge)|Cool Ducky]], [[Fat Ducky (D00M's Revenge)|Fat Ducky]] and [[Spy Ducky (D00M's Revenge)|Spy Ducky]]. The '''Eggroll''' can be spawned by the [[Cart]], though this does not always function properly. Beyond wave 20, it would be able to spawn naturally. ==Appearance== The '''Eggroll''' was a white egg that moved by rolling on the ground. ==Event Strategy== As this enemy only appears through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, no strategy section is made for its current version. Instead, a strategy section for the one that appeared without [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode in [[D00M's Revenge]] is listed instead. *Cheap towers like the [[Soldier]] and [[Golden Scout]] fare well against the '''Eggroll'''. **Multiple [[Sniper]]s are recommended for their long range, letting them defeat the '''Eggroll''' from further away, making it easier to deal with the spawned enemies. In addition, the [[Sniper]] can also counter the [[Flying Ducky (D00M's Revenge)|Flying Ducky]] that debuts later on in the game. *As '''Eggrolls''' always spawn in groups of three from the [[Cart]], towers that can damage multiple enemies at once, like the [[Executioner]], are recommended. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Thumbnails}} DuckHuntEvent.png|'''Eggroll''' on the game thumbnail. {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Images}} DuckHuntPI.png|'''Eggroll''' on a promotional image. {{GalleryHeader|Trailers}} Tower Defense Simulator- Spring Trailer|'''Eggroll''' in the game trailer. {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} EggrollIconIG.png|'''Eggroll''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *Due to the [[Cart]], the '''Eggroll''' could spawn before its debut wave. *This enemy can be seen in the {{Color|Ducky|Ducky}} skin for the [[Farm]]. ==Update History == *'''17 April 2022''' - [[v1.2.0]] **'''Eggroll''' added. *'''28 May 2022''' - [[v1.2.4]] **'''Eggroll''' removed. *'''16 April 2025''' - [[v1.61.0]] **'''Eggroll''' can now be appear in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, only when the player summons the legacy [[Mother Ducky (D00M's Revenge)|Mother Ducky]] which then summons in the [[Cart]] that upon death summons in the '''Eggroll'''. ==Notes== {{D00MRevenge2|[[Long Ducky (D00M's Revenge)|Long Ducky]]
